import sys
from itertools import islice


def tokens():
    # Stream whitespace-separated tokens in 1 MiB chunks.
    read = sys.stdin.buffer.read
    rest = b""
    while True:
        chunk = read(1 << 20)
        if not chunk:
            break
        chunk = rest + chunk
        cut = max(chunk.rfind(b" "), chunk.rfind(b"\n"))
        if cut < 0:
            rest = chunk
            continue
        rest = chunk[cut:]
        yield from chunk[:cut].split()
    yield from rest.split()


def main():
    it = tokens()
    q = int(next(it))
    ids = {}  # ip -> number in order of first appearance
    order = []
    seen_twice = bytearray()  # 1 once an ip has appeared at least twice
    p = 0  # every ip numbered below p has appeared at least twice
    out = []
    write = sys.stdout.buffer.write
    for cmd in islice(it, q):
        if cmd[0] == 65:  # ADD: its ip is the next token
            ip = next(it)
            i = ids.get(ip)
            if i is None:
                ids[ip] = len(order)
                order.append(ip)
                seen_twice.append(0)
            else:
                seen_twice[i] = 1
        else:  # FIRST_UNIQUE
            n = len(order)
            while p < n and seen_twice[p]:
                p += 1
            out.append(order[p] if p < n else b"")
            if len(out) == 65536:
                out.append(b"")
                write(b"\n".join(out))
                out.clear()
    if out:
        out.append(b"")
        write(b"\n".join(out))


main()
